mei-you-vs-bu-yong.label: 没有 + verb vs 不用 + verb
recurring_errors: Interpreted 没有上班 as 'didn't have to work' rather than 'didn't work/go to work'.
example_patterns: 没有上班 = did not work/go to work
不用上班 = do not need to work
notes: Review in a later session with different verbs, not just 上班.
2026-09-28: correctly distinguished 没有去 from 不用去, but still read 没有上班 as 'didn't have to work' and 不用上班 as simple 'don't work' in later items.

2026-09-29–30: strong improvement across many mixed sentences; learner usually distinguished 没有 'did not' from 不用 'do not/have to'. Remaining errors were mostly tense/context rather than the core semantic contrast.
2026-10-01–03: distinction remained reliable in mixed sentences.
2026-10-05–08: 不用 remains strong and is now also distinguished from 不能 and 还要.

xiang-modal.label: 想 + verb for desire/intention
recurring_errors: Translated 想去 as a simple future 'am going to' and omitted the desire/intention nuance.
Occasionally rendered 不想 as 'didn't want to' when the sentence had no past-time cue.
example_patterns: 想去 = want to go / would like to go
notes: 2026-09-28: correctly recognized 想/不想 as want to / don't want to in three sentences.
2026-09-29–30: desire meaning is well recognized; current issue is interpreting time reference from context.
2026-10-01–03: 想 consistently recognized as desire/intention; remaining questions concern English tense choice, not 想 itself.
2026-10-04–08: 想 remains highly reliable in complex multi-clause sentences.

adjective-de-noun.label: Adjective + 的 + noun
recurring_errors: 辣的东西 was not parsed as 'spicy things/food'.
example_patterns: 辣的东西 = spicy things / spicy food
notes: Keep examples concrete and high-frequency.

habitual-time-frequency.label: Habitual time/frequency expressions
recurring_errors: Dropped or misread modifiers such as 每天, 周末, 有时候, 通常, 星期天.
example_patterns: 每天 = every day
周末 = on weekends
常常 = often
有时候 = sometimes
通常 = usually
notes: 常常 is currently strong; several neighboring frequency/time words remain shaky.
2026-09-28: 常常 was consistently correct. 有时候 and 通常 were each correct multiple times but were still occasionally swapped. 星期天 improved after one miss.
2026-09-29–30: weekdays and frequency words were mostly correct in varied sentences. One early 通常→sometimes error and one 星期六→Friday mix-up.
2026-10-01–03: frequency expressions remained strong; one 星期五→Wednesday weekday slip occurred on 2026-10-03.
2026-10-04–08: routine/frequency expressions remain stable; no new frequency-word confusion observed.
2026-10-27: Reliable recognition of usually, sometimes and past routines.

cause-result-suoyi.label: 所以 for cause-result ('so / therefore')
recurring_errors: Interpreted 所以 as 'then' rather than 'so / therefore'.
example_patterns: A，所以B = A, so B
notes: Review later in a simple cause-result sentence.
2026-09-29–30: 所以 was correctly translated as so/therefore repeatedly; earlier confusion appears largely resolved.
2026-10-01–03: 所以 consistently recognized as so/therefore.
2026-10-04–08: 所以 is now consistently automatic in recognition.
2026-10-27: Consistently correct.

time-reference-from-context.label: Time reference from context rather than verb conjugation
recurring_errors: Rendered 不想去 as 'didn't want to go' when context indicated current/future desire.
Rendered 不用去/不用上班 as past 'didn't have to' when no past-time cue was present.
Occasionally chooses a natural English tense that is more specific than the Mandarin itself, while explicitly recognizing the ambiguity.
example_patterns: 昨天没有去 = didn't go yesterday
今天想去 = want to go today
这个星期三不想去 = don't want to go this Wednesday
星期五不用上班 = don't have to work Friday (unless broader context makes Friday past)
notes: Focus on explicit time expressions and discourse context; Mandarin verbs themselves are not conjugated for tense.

2026-10-01–03: major improvement. Learner explicitly identified tense ambiguity when Mandarin lacked a past/future cue and correctly used context such as 昨天/今天早上. A couple of English renderings mixed tenses despite correct Mandarin parsing.

2026-10-04–08: learner repeatedly and explicitly identified tense ambiguity correctly and supplied context-sensitive English tense. One or two translations still overcommitted to past tense, but awareness is now a strength.

sequence-xian-zai-ranhou-yihou.label: Sequencing with 先…再… / 然后 / 以后
recurring_errors: 先 was unknown on first encounter.
再 was unknown on first encounter.
下班以后 was omitted from two otherwise-correct translations before later being handled correctly.
One 以前 sentence was reversed as 'after' on 2026-10-04.
example_patterns: X 以后 Y = after X, Y
先 X，再 Y = first X, then Y
X，然后 Y = X, then/after that Y
notes: Learner explicitly asked how 然后 differs from 以后 and then applied the distinction correctly.
先…再… was learned quickly after explanation and is now usually recognized correctly.
Continue mixing all three patterns without isolated drilling.
2026-10-04–08: 先…再…, 然后, and 以后 are now strong. New weakness is specifically 以前 vs 以后 rather than general sequencing.
2026-10-27: Strong first/then/after sequencing.

before-after-yiqian-yihou.label: 以前 vs 以后 for before/after
recurring_errors: Reversed 睡觉以前 as 'after going to bed' once after initially understanding it correctly.
example_patterns: X 以前 = before X
X 以后 = after X
notes: Improving quickly; later contrasts were correct. Keep in mixed-context review rather than isolated memorization.
2026-10-27: Before/after distinction improving and reliable in latest session.

result-complement-wan.label: Result complement 完 for completed actions
recurring_errors: 完 was unknown on first explicit encounter in 吃完早饭.
example_patterns: 吃完 = finish eating
做完 = finish doing
看完 = finish reading/watching
notes: Learner now clearly distinguishes plain 做 from 做完 and explicitly notices when a sentence does not promise future completion.
2026-10-27: Correctly distinguishes finish from do.

potential-complements.label: Potential complements with 得/不 between verb and result
recurring_errors: First 做不完 was interpreted as merely 'not finished' rather than 'cannot finish'.
example_patterns: 做得完 = be able to finish
做不完 = be unable to finish
notes: After explanation, 做不完 was recognized correctly in later sentences. Continue with familiar verbs before broadening.

modal-contrast.label: 不用 / 不能 / 可以 / 要 / 还要 / 只能 modal contrast
recurring_errors: 还要工作 was once misread as 'don't have to work'.
只能 was unknown on first encounter.
example_patterns: 不用 = don't have to
不能 = can't
可以 = can/may
还要 = still have to
只能 = can only
notes: Core 不用/不能/可以 contrast is strong. 还要 and 只能 are newer but improving rapidly.
2026-10-27: 只能 strong; 才能 specifically confused with 'has to'.

shenme-dou-negative.label: 什么…都不… for 'not ... anything/anywhere'
recurring_errors: 什么都不想做 was not parsed on first encounter.
example_patterns: 什么都不想做 = don't want to do anything
什么地方都不想去 = don't want to go anywhere
notes: After one miss, learner translated several variants correctly and understood the role of 地方.
2026-10-27: 哪里也没去 initially missed, then understood as didn't go anywhere.

measure-word-jian.label: Number + 件 + 事情 measure-word pattern
recurring_errors: 两件 was unknown on first encounter.
example_patterns: 一件事情 = one thing/task
两件事情 = two things/tasks
五件事情 = five things/tasks
notes: Recognition improved immediately and remained correct in later numbered-task sentences.

jiu-condition-sequence.label: 就 for tight condition/result sequencing
recurring_errors: Initially unknown; later inserted 'can' into 就出去 even though 可以 was absent.
example_patterns: 做完以后就可以回家 = once finished, can go home
做完以后就出去 = once finished, go out
notes: Learner understands the 'once X, then Y' force but should keep 就 distinct from 可以.

de-manner-complement.label: Verb + 得 + description
example_patterns: 睡得太晚 = sleep/go to bed too late
工作得很累 = work to the point of being very tired
notes: Meaning was captured naturally in English; formal structure is still new.

tai-le-degree.label: 太…了 degree construction
example_patterns: 太累了 = too/really tired
事情太多了 = there are too many things
notes: Learner correctly noticed that natural English may render 太 as 'very/really' rather than literal 'too' depending on context.

benlai-contrast.label: 本来 for original intention/state contrasted with reality
recurring_errors: 本来 looked familiar but was not recalled on first encounter.
example_patterns: 本来想今天都做完 = originally wanted to finish everything today
notes: Subsequent sentence was translated correctly; keep paired with 但是/可是-style contrast.
2026-10-27: Repeatedly recognized originally intended.

liu-dao-endpoint.label: 留到 + time for leaving something until an endpoint
recurring_errors: 留 and 到 were both uncertain on first encounter; 到 was guessed to mean completion.
example_patterns: 留到明天 = leave until tomorrow
留到明天再做 = leave it until tomorrow and do it then
notes: Learner now distinguishes endpoint 到 from completion 完 and explicitly noticed 再做 does not imply 做完.

de-nominalization-rest.label: 的 nominalization in 剩下的
recurring_errors: 剩下的 was uncertain on first encounter.
example_patterns: 剩下的 = the remaining ones / the rest
notes: Recognized correctly on the next occurrence.

ma-shang-zhi-jie.label: 马上 vs 直接
example_patterns: 马上 = immediately
直接 = directly
notes: 2026-10-27: Initially swapped, then accurately distinguished.

cai-neng.label: 才 / 才能 delayed ability
example_patterns: 才来 = did not arrive until then
才能回家 = only then can go home
notes: 2026-10-27: 才 delay nuance and 才能 ability need review.

gen-yiqi.label: 跟…一起 accompaniment
example_patterns: 跟朋友一起 = together with a friend
notes: 2026-10-27: Both words explicitly forgotten, though 跟 inferred from context.

duration-jiu.label: 很久 and 还是没做完
example_patterns: 做了很久 = worked a long time
还是没做完 = still did not finish
notes: 2026-10-27: Duration mistaken for effort once.

nali-ye.label: 哪里也没去
example_patterns: 哪里也没去 = did not go anywhere
notes: 2026-10-27: First translated as didn't go there; then correctly recognized.
